_comment: Capability-gap justification for every retained AWS path (Prompt 14 Part F item 6). GENERATED from services/ml/app/predict/capability_gaps.py — edit that module, not this file. validate_capability_gaps() guards parity + content.

aws_paths.aws_runtime: SageMaker async endpoint / AWS Batch (GPU: g5/g6, ~3 GiB BF16 weights)
aws_paths.gap_reason: Catalyst exposes no custom GPU runtime and cannot host a ~3 GiB BF16 foundation-model for in-context inference; QuickML/Zia AutoML do not provide TabFM. GPU inference is the genuine capability gap.
aws_paths.crosses_boundary: ids, versions, content hashes, feature vectors, observation cutoff (labelled context rows or an approved s3 snapshot uri) — never narrative/evidence/PII/DATABASE_URL.
aws_paths.not_replacing: Operational data stays in Catalyst Data Store; only the aggregate feature vector is sent, and results return as NEW records.

aws_paths.gap_reason: No Catalyst service runs a pretrained time-series foundation model on GPU; the CPU statistical baseline in AppSail is the eligible comparator, not a replacement for TimesFM.
aws_paths.crosses_boundary: compact incident-count series, frequency, horizon, cutoff and approved dynamic-covariate versions — aggregates only.
aws_paths.not_replacing: The AppSail CPU baseline (QuickML/stats) still runs on Catalyst for comparison; AWS is used only for the GPU foundation model.

aws_paths.capability: Spatio-temporal graph neural network area forecast
aws_paths.gap_reason: A torch-geometric ST-GNN needs a GPU + a heavy graph stack that Catalyst does not provide.
aws_paths.crosses_boundary: time-by-area count tensor, versioned adjacency/geometry ids and approved context — no person nodes, no invalid geography.
aws_paths.not_replacing: Deterministic graph community/centrality/path analytics stay on Catalyst/PostGIS/NetworkX; only the GPU model runs on AWS.

aws_paths.capability: PostGIS/pgRouting geospatial routing + heavy spatial analytics
aws_paths.aws_runtime: Retained AWS RDS (read-only, drishti_readonly, IAM DB auth)
aws_paths.gap_reason: Catalyst Data Store is not a spatial database: no PostGIS geometry ops and no pgRouting graph routing. Used only-where-necessary, read-only.
aws_paths.crosses_boundary: geometry ids, area/beat ids and aggregate query parameters — no operational rows are written; RDS never on the CRUD path.
aws_paths.not_replacing: Operational relational records + search are served by Catalyst Data Store; RDS is a private, read-only analytics adapter only (F.2).

aws_paths.capability: Private model-artifact registry + GPU execution (image + weights)
aws_paths.aws_runtime: Private ECR image (services/gpu-worker) + SageMaker/Batch + temporary S3 staging
aws_paths.gap_reason: Catalyst has no container registry or GPU execution plane for a CUDA image with multi-GiB model weights; the model-artifact lifecycle (build, digest-pin, load, verify) must run on AWS.
aws_paths.crosses_boundary: model/version/artifact digests + temporary feature I/O objects in an approved S3 staging prefix — never the operational object store.
aws_paths.not_replacing: Application objects (evidence/import/report) live in Catalyst Stratus; S3 is only temporary SageMaker/Batch I/O staging.
